analysis: descriptive offline parsing; no simulation and no causal identification from aggregate association

generation_exposure_partition.definition: Founder exposure is exact founder-ID exposure through death_tick-1 (or horizon); descendant exposure is the validated population living-individual-tick total minus founders. This is an accounting partition, not causal mediation or individual descendant matching.

focused_negative_seed_pairs.lineage_signature_note: Within-run ID/tick lineage events are retained. After parent identity or birth timing diverges, equal numeric IDs across arms are not presumed to identify the same individual.
